title: Settings
lead: Set up how the app looks, your profile, security and your practice plan. Display settings are saved on this device.

signIn.title: Sign in first
signIn.body: You need an account to {what}. It's free, and your progress is saved too.
signIn.profile: set your photo, name and username

language.title: Language
language.hint: When you're signed in, this is saved to your account. Otherwise it's saved on this device.

theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: System follows your device's light/dark setting.

font.title: Font
font.hint: OpenDyslexic weights the bottom of each letter so letters don't flip around. Atkinson Hyperlegible makes look-alike characters (I, l, 1) easy to tell apart.

motion.title: Motion
motion.hint: Reduce turns off animation on this site only, without changing your device settings.
motion.systemSub: Full animation, unless your device asks for less

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.hint: Wide screens only. You can also use the button at the top of the sidebar.

profile.usernameIdle: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers or underscores.
profile.invalid: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only. 3–20 characters.
profile.usernameDisabled: Usernames can be set once account features are enabled on the server.

emailForm.sentBody: We sent a link to {email}. Your email only changes once you open it. Check your old inbox too: for security, the change may need confirming from there as well.

avatar.formats: JPG, PNG or WebP. Cropped to a square automatically.
avatar.notImage: Choose an image file (JPG, PNG or WebP).
avatar.tooBig: Photos can be up to 10 MB.
avatar.failed: Couldn't upload the photo. Please try again.

errors.notReady: This feature isn't enabled on the server yet. Try again later.
errors.nameTooLong: Names can be up to 60 characters.
errors.usernameRule: Usernames are 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers or underscores (_).
errors.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Try another one.
errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Please try again in a moment.
errors.newTooShort: Your new password is too short. Use at least {min} characters.
errors.newMismatch: The two new passwords don't match.
